sloka: अस्याहं दर्शनाकांक्षी प्राप्तस्त्वद्भवनं विभो ।मारुतस्यौरसः पुत्रो वानरो हनुमानहम् ।। ५.५८.१३२ ।।।।
transliteration: asyāhaṁ darśanākāṁkṣī prāptastvadbhavanaṁ vibho ।mārutasyaurasaḥ putro vānaro hanumānaham ।। 5.58.132 ।।।।

translations.english: 'I have done all this for the sake of Sita, O demon king I came to your mansion desiring to see Sita. I am the legitimate son of Windgod. My name is Hanuman.
